data.one_liner: A scaffold widget providing a sidebar and an app bar for admin panels.
data.what_it_does: It provides an AdminScaffold class that integrates an adjustable sidebar with an app bar and body area. It supports hierarchical menu items, headers, footers, and routing handlers out of the box.
use_when: You are building an admin dashboard or a desktop/web app requiring a collapsible sidebar navigation.
You want a pre-built layout structure combining an AppBar and a SideBar.
avoid_when: You need complex navigation with advanced deep linking handled directly by a routing package.
You are building a mobile-first app that does not require a persistent sidebar layout.
strengths: Quickly sets up standard admin panel layouts.
Supports nested menu items inside the sidebar.
Cross-platform support including web and desktop.
weaknesses: Limited to specific admin layout paradigms.
Lacks integrated routing features, requiring manual navigation handling.
